slides.say: The linter wants a dependency you do not like. So you silence it. Here is what happens.
This timer should add increment every second. The linter was silenced and the list forced to empty.

slides.text: It keeps the first onTick forever: count 0, increment 1. The screen shows 1, always.
slides.say: React keeps using the on tick from the first render, where count was zero. So every second it sets one. The counter is stuck at one.

slides.text: Treat the lint error like a compile error. Change the code, not the list.
slides.say: Treat the dependency lint error like a compile error. The list describes your code. To change the list, change the code.
